company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: How do ecommerce brands choose corrugated mailer box structure and print finish?
answer: Ecommerce brands should choose corrugated mailer structure by product size, packed weight, shipping protection, retail display need, print coverage and unboxing expectation. MUGE PACKAGING separates packaging structure review from food-contact or destination-market compliance review, which must be handled with project documents.
rfq_inputs: Mailer style, flap direction and closure expectation
Retail display or ecommerce unboxing requirement
Target market and any food-contact document-review need
